title: On standby, a signal that arrives while you are away stays on screen instead of playing to an empty chair
config:
[presence]
standby = true
notify_when_away = true
digest_on_return = false

steps.note: At the desk, a finished turn flashes and fades as usual
Away: the flash is held up, and the notification still goes out
Still away ten minutes later, and nothing new is shown; the held flash is already up
Back at the desk. The input that dismissed the held flash also ends being away, and the digest is off here
